def read_record(records, actor, record_id):
    row = records.get(record_id)
    if row is None:
        return None
    same_tenant = row["tenant_id"] == actor["tenant_id"]
    same_owner = row["owner_id"] == actor["id"]
    return row if same_tenant and same_owner else None
